english.note: Use 風聲 for a rumor or indications that something may be happening.
Choose this when the buzz is a rumour or information circulating behind the scenes rather than simply a hot topic.
Use this for news or a rumour heard indirectly, as in catching wind of something.

examples.english: There has been a whisper lately that the company may lay people off.
examples.traditional: 最近有風聲話公司會裁員。
examples.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 jau5 fung1 sing1 waa6 gung1 si1 wui5 coi4 jyun4

examples.english: I heard a buzz that the company will lay people off next month.
examples.traditional: 我聽到風聲，話公司下個月會裁員。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 dou2 fung1 sing1 waa6 gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 coi4 jyun4

examples.english: I caught wind that prices will go up tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 我聽到風聲，話聽日會加價。
